notes: Primary pain: agent desktop latency + compliance overhead — ~12k monthly support interactions, mix of PHI and cardholder data

Latency target: <200ms token latency for interactive agent assist during peak (6k concurrent agents spikes unpredictable). Throughput: burstable to 500 rps for short windows.
Cost sensitivity: mid — will trade incremental cost for deterministic latency and audited controls. Interested in Optimize recommendations for batching/quantization.
Security notes: must run in VPC w/ no public egress for KV cache. KMS/HSM required for key management. Data residency requirement: US-only processing and retention controls configurable per-tenant.
Quote from Director of Support: "We cannot have model logs leak PHI or CC info — audit trail is non-negotiable." Wants explicit audit logging and retention policy mapping.

Security review: SOC2 and ISO27001 certifications acceptable baseline; also require PCI DSS attestation for card-related flows and signed DPA with breach procedures.
SE notes: need to validate HSM integration path (customer uses AWS CloudHSM) and confirm KV cache encryption at rest + in transit. Also explore per-tenant retention controls in Console.
Follow-ups: send VPC POC checklist, draft runbook, and estimated infra diagram. Legal requested sample DPA and SOC2 report (link in Drive).
